items.exampleEn: I do my homework after dinner.
My parents are at work. They come home at six.
items.exampleZh: 我爸媽在上班，他們六點回家。

items.exampleEn: I get up at seven every day.
I like tea, but I do not like coffee.
items.exampleZh: 我喜歡茶，但是我不喜歡咖啡。

items.exampleEn: We are in the same class.

items.audioEn: Tom is from Japan, but he lives here now.
items.audioZh: Tom 來自日本，但他現在住在這裡。

items.sentenceEn: They do their homework at home.

items.stemEn: I like milk, ____ my sister does not.
items.stemZh: 我喜歡牛奶，但是我妹妹不喜歡。
這封信是我奶奶寄來的。

items.passageEn: Kevin and his brother are from Japan. They live in Taipei now. Every Saturday, they go to the park at nine. Kevin likes to play ball, but his brother likes to read. We often see them there.
items.passageZh: Kevin 和他的弟弟來自日本，他們現在住在台北。每個星期六，他們九點去公園。Kevin 喜歡打球，但他弟弟喜歡看書。我們常在那裡看到他們。

questions.questionZh: Kevin 和弟弟星期六幾點去公園？
Kevin 的弟弟喜歡做什麼？

rubricZh: 用 this 指近處的東西

items.instructionZh: 用 but 造一個句子，說說你喜歡和不喜歡的兩樣食物。
referenceEn: I like apples, but I do not like bananas.
I like rice, but I do not like fish.
rubricZh: 用 but 連接意思相反的兩部分
表達不喜歡時可用 do not（don't）like
but 後面可以是完整句子，也可以是省略寫法（例如 but not bananas）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 要求 but 前後兩部分都有主詞和動詞，會排除同樣正確的省略寫法（如 I like apples, but not bananas.）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 要點改為「but 後面可以是完整句子，也可以是省略寫法（例如 but not bananas）」
